newsitem.title: USA: Nov U.S. aluminum shipments fell 8.5 pct from Oct.
newsitem.headline: Nov U.S. aluminum shipments fell 8.5 pct from Oct.

text.p: Aluminum Association said preliminary figures for November 1996 indicate that industry shipments, including exports, totaled 1.681 billion lbs, down 8.5 percent from a revised 1.838 billion lbs in October.
Shipments in November were up 4.2 percent on the same month in 1995.
January to November shipments fell 1.9 percent to 19.176 billion lbs.
U.S. exports of aluminum ingot and mill products were 247 million lbs in November, up 8.7 percent over November 1995 exports.
Imports in November totaled 443 million lbs, up 1.4 percent over a year ago.
Estimated net new industry orders of aluminum mill products, totaled 1.217 billion lbs in December, up 4.5 percent over December 1995.
